  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  na = c("", "NA"), locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))

snippets.code:
# Accessible scatter: colour-blind-flagged Brewer palette plus shapes. Dark2 holds
# at most 8 colours and is never recycled or interpolated; more groups need
# labelled facets or direct labels instead of more colours.
groups <- unique(data[["<group>"]])
stopifnot(length(groups) <= 8L)
colours <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3L, length(groups)), "Dark2")[seq_along(groups)]
plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[["<x>"]], y = .data[["<y>"]],
    colour = .data[["<group>"]], shape = .data[["<group>"]])) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() + ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = colours)
patchwork::wrap_plots(list(plot)) + patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
snippets.input_class: data.frame with deliberately reviewed column classes

classes.<group>: factor or character; at most 8 groups

# Inspect missingness in explicitly mapped columns before deciding exclusions.
# Complete-case filtering is shown explicitly; review its assumptions and record excluded rows.
roles <- data[c("<variable-1>", "<variable-2>")]
missing_by_column <- colSums(is.na(roles))
keep <- stats::complete.cases(roles)
excluded_rows <- which(!keep)
complete_data <- roles[keep, , drop = FALSE]
